name: KpiCard
summary: A single-metric card. Composes: eyebrow label (KPI name) → headline value (large numeric, tabular-nums) → Trend delta → optional Sparkline → optional context line. The denominator of a dashboard. Distinct from Stat (smaller inline value with no trend) and from Chart (multi-series).

value.description: Headline number. Render via .lumen-tnum for tabular alignment.

valueSuffix.description: Unit suffix ('%', 'mi', ' MB'). Renders smaller next to value.

deltaPeriod.description: Period the delta is measured against ('vs last 7 days').

context.description: Optional bottom line — extra context like 'Driven by Sterling LTL'.

tone.description: accent: value renders in text.accent (use sparingly for a single highlight KPI on the surface).

loading.description: Renders Skeleton placeholders for value, delta, sparkline.

onClick.description: When set, the entire card becomes a button + routes to a detail view.

rules: Root role='region' + aria-label that includes label + value + delta ('Revenue, $1.4M, up 12% versus last 7 days').
Loading state sets aria-busy='true' and announces 'Loading KPI' once via sr-only.
Interactive cards (onClick) are buttons; non-interactive cards are <article>.

do: One headline metric per card. Two metrics = two cards.
Use tabular-nums on value + delta so a grid of KPIs aligns vertically.
Pair with Trend + Sparkline for at-a-glance context.
Use tone='accent' for the single most important KPI on the surface; default for the rest.
dont: Don't put two competing numbers in one card.
Don't render the value larger than type.heading.h2 — the headline is meant to be scannable, not heroic.
Don't omit period reference when delta is present — '12%' alone is ambiguous.
